criteria.anchors_run: >=6 of 7 days, four consecutive weeks, all four bells (Lauds, Sext, Vespers, Compline) answered
criteria.not_in_desolation: no promotion on a good week's high, no deletion on a bad week's low
criteria.resume_lines: >=80% of the bells that close a focus session with something picked carry a resume line
criteria.rule_stable: weekly review proposed no change for two consecutive weeks
criteria.slot_empty: the named slot is free, and what it displaces is named

gate.novitiate_scale: once a week, not daily — freely revocable, logged as no kind of failure
